data.body: Fixed: _advisory_lock now uses 'git worktree add --detach' + 'git update-ref refs/heads/tickets <new> <old>' to advance the tickets branch ref without an exclusive-checkout conflict with the CI workflow's pre-mounted .tickets-tracker worktree. Applied symmetrically to _write_file_to_tickets_branch and _delete_file_from_tickets_branch (H2 latent defect). 2 new dual-worktree tests close the recurring blind-spot. PR #354 https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/354 (branch fix-96c5-fetch-tickets-branch, commit af12b46ecf).
